entries.text: Designed a new look for Little Dart Mk 24: a sleek, needle-nosed hull with swept-back stub wings, coated in matte rust-orange primer and ready to chase the stars, bweep.
sketching sleek fuselage lines and sweeping wing curves for the Little Dart

entries.detail: A sleek, needle-nosed hull with swept-back stub wings, coated in matte rust-orange primer with polished titanium trim lines around the twin aft thrusters.
